title: Delhi traffic advisory October 10: full list of 30 diversion points - Business Upturn
full_text:
Delhi Traffic Police has issued an advisory for Saturday, October 10, listing 30 points across New Delhi and Central Delhi where diversions may be enforced from 6 am.
The advisory cites "the law and order situation" and says the measures will be applied "depending upon prevailing situation".
The 30 points named
Movement at these points and the stretches around them "might remain affected":
Round About Shankar Road - Vande Matram 'T' Point towards New Delhi
Dhaula Kuan Flyover
Round About Jhandewalan
Round About Panchkuian
Round About Mandi House

Ram Charan Aggarwal Chowk (A-Point)

Round About Gol Dak Khana

What commuters are being told
Plan in advance. Keep extra travel time in hand if heading towards railway stations, ISBTs or the airport via New Delhi and Central Delhi.
Avoid non-essential travel. Commuters have been asked not to undertake journeys that can wait.
Expect the restrictions to change through the day. The advisory describes the measures as dynamic, to be "relaxed or regulated based on real-time ground assessment".
The stretch worth noting
The list runs well beyond the protest site. It covers the approaches to Connaught Place from several directions, the roundabouts along Ashoka Road and Sansad Marg, and arterial points as far out as Dhaula Kuan, Moti Bagh and Bhikaji Cama Place.
That spread is the practical point for anyone travelling on Saturday. A diversion at Dhaula Kuan or Lodhi Road Flyover affects journeys that have nothing to do with central Delhi, including routes to the airport.
Where to check on the day
Because the restrictions are being applied dynamically, the advisory directs commuters to official channels for live updates rather than the list alone:
Website: traffic.delhipolice.gov.in
X, Instagram and Facebook: @dtptraffic
Helplines: 1095 or 011-25844444
Why the restrictions are in place
The advisory does not name the event. It coincides with a protest called at Jantar Mantar for October 10 by the Cockroach Janta Party, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls.
Permission for that gathering has been refused. On Friday evening Delhi Police set out its reasons for refusing permission, citing injuries to police personnel during protests at the same site in July. Separately, the Cockroach Janta Party has said the protest will go ahead regardless.
At a glance
Diversions may begin at 6 am on October 10
30 points listed across New Delhi and Central Delhi
Commuters heading to railway stations, ISBTs or the airport advised to allow extra time
Helplines: 1095 and 011-25844444
